We know: 1. $x = 3y$ (You are three times as old as your cousin) 2. $x + 10 = 2(y + 10)$ (In 10 years, you will be twice as old as your cousin) Substitute the first equation into the second: $3y + 10 = 2(y + 10)$ Solve for y: $3y + 10 = 2y + 20$ $3y - 2y = 20 - 10$ $y = 10$ Now find x using the first equation: $x = 3(10) = 30$ You are **30 years old**.
